renderer: Unreal Engine 5.8 · Game Animation Sample · independently animated and measured skeleton. Each comparison has its own level and sequence.
editorialNotes: Compare the same native TwinBlast face, camera, material and light while changing brow, eyelid and jaw. Maintain retouch concept, mouth anatomy, sclera/teeth contrast, view scale, expressive bodies and deliberate restraint. The overlays and test curves refer only to our rig. Keep the named mermaid in view throughout her narration using the separately credited full battle recording; both Cuphead recordings represent one game.

nintendo.basis: Nintendo developed and published Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Clock Tower 3 and Cuphead show contrasting facial proportions and camera distance.

previousEpisode: A11 examined attack timing. This time Animal Crossing faces, a Clock Tower close-up and Cuphead's drawn features provide a different set of actual examples.
sourceCredits: Epic Games · Game Animation Sample · 자체 비교 동작 — https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/game-animation-sample-project-in-unreal-engine

revisedKo.1.1: 동물의 숲에서 콩돌이와 밤돌이가 같은 자리에서 눈을 깜빡입니다. 입과 몸은 크게 움직이지 않아도 눈을 다시 뜨는 순간 표정이 살아나죠.

1.6.ko: 두 눈의 흰 부분이 보였다가 눈꺼풀 아래로 사라지는 걸 보세요. 작은 얼굴 안에서도 어디가 움직였는지가 분명합니다.
1.6.en: Watch the whites appear and disappear under the lids. Even on a small face, we can tell which feature changed.

3.9.ko: 컵헤드의 인어는 입을 크게 벌린 다음 다시 오므립니다. 몸이 크게 움직이지 않아도 입 모양 하나가 화면에서 또렷하게 보이죠.
3.9.en: Cuphead’s mermaid opens her mouth wide, then closes it. The mouth shape reads even with little body movement.
